pages.text: Sneak and right-click $(item)stone$() with a smithing hammer to make a $(item)Stone Smithing Anvil$(); sneak and right-click a vanilla $(item)anvil$() to make an iron $(item)Smithing Anvil$().

Every forging recipe has a $(thing)tier$(): stone, iron, then the tiers above iron. An anvil forges its own tier and those below it. The $(l:thaumageared:arcane/arcane_anvil)Arcane Anvil$() is the tier above iron.
Right-click with the hammer to start forging, right-click away from the anvil to stop. One anvil, one smith at a time.
